description: Calculate SANS 10400-O statutory natural lighting (min. 10% floor area) and natural ventilation (min. 5% openable sash area) compliance for habitable rooms.

actual_glazed_area_m2.description: Total installed window glazed area in square metres (m²).

actual_openable_area_m2.description: Total installed clear openable window sash ventilation area in square metres (m²).

floor_area_m2.description: Internal floor area of the habitable room in square metres (m²).

room_name.description: Name or label of the habitable room (e.g. "Bedroom 1", "Living Room", "Study").

name: calculate_sans_fenestration
